## About
Rio Import Auto Center is an independently owned, family run shop in Peachtree Corners, just by Norcross. We work only on Honda and Acura vehicles, and we've been in the same spot on Spalding Drive for a long time, long enough to earn a reputation as Atlanta's Honda specialist.
Chris Fernandes, the owner, is a Georgia Tech grad who is certified and Honda factory trained. We use original Honda parts, and we try to make every visit as easy and care free as we can.
We also like being part of the neighborhood. We sponsor local groups like the Norcross Blue Devil Touchdown Club and the IHM Running Eagles.

## Services
- Oil change: Oil and filter change, plus a brake inspection, tire pressure check, fluid check and a look at other major parts.
- Maintenance: Every car's needs are a little different. Call and we'll tell you what maintenance yours needs.
- Timing belt package: New timing belt, water pump, camshaft seal and drive belts, fresh coolant and a road test.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on cars other than Honda and Acura?
A: No. We work only on Honda and Acura vehicles.

Q: How do I make an appointment?
A: Give us a call and we'll get you on the schedule.

Q: How long will my car be in the shop?
A: In most cases we can finish the work in one day.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., and closed on weekends.
